name: Berimish
description: Largest Viashino city and the last in the valley to fall.

description_citations.text: "The Prodigal Sorcerer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Timni subdues Berimish's defenses, letting Tagard take the city and the entire valley without a battle.
timeline.quote: Using magic, Timni subdued Berimish’s defenses

citation.text: "Betrayal of Tamingazin", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tagard forms a ruling council with all three races over strong opposition, while Tallibeth befriends Recin.
timeline.quote: Tagard formed a ruling council that included representatives from all three races, despite strong opposition.

citation.text: "Betrayal of Tamingazin", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ursal Daleel helps Tagard Tarngold's coup in Berimish by opening the Splendant Hall, costing Bey Lisolo his position.
timeline.quote: allowing Bey Lisolo , the Viashino ruler, to lose his position

citation.text: "Suderbod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ursal has Aligarius make an amulet for Tagard, then assassinates Tagard with a crossbow bolt from a rooftop.
timeline.quote: Ursal fired the fatal crossbow bolt himself from a rooftop using a Viashino weapon.

citation.text: "Suderbod", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Timni uses magic to take Berimish without bloodshed; Lisolo is invited onto the council.
timeline.quote: uses magic to have the army sneak into the castle and take the city without bloodshed

timeline.summary: Talli hires Recin as guide and warms to him and Viashino culture.
timeline.quote: Talli recruits the Garan Elf Recin to be her guide around Berimish.

timeline.summary: Ursal Daleel befriends the restless Timni and hooks him on drugs from Suderbod.
timeline.quote: he deviously hooks Timni up with drugs produced in Suderbod

timeline.summary: Tagard is assassinated with a Viashino crossbow; Karelon takes power and accuses Recin.
